original_question: Dave zụtara nnukwu ngwugwu ihe eghere eghe frenchị ma taa iri na anọ tutu seagull agụ n'agụ zuru ngwugwu ahụ n'aka ya. Emechaa, rakuunu zuru ụzọ abụọ n'ime atọ ihe eghere eghe fọdụrụ. Ndanda bupuru nke ịkpeazụ ihe eghere eghe fọdụrụ, were hapụ ise n'azụ. Ihe eghere eghe ole dị n'ime ngwugwu ahụ mgbe Dave zụtara ya?
